checkedAlternates.risk: Spring tides occur on a fortnightly cycle.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Spring and neap tides describe fortnightly amplitude extremes from Sun–Moon alignment (group-2), whereas diurnal/semidiurnal/mixed/nodal describe periodic waveform types (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: A tidal bore is an incoming surge of water.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A tidal bore is a solitary wave propagating upriver against the current (group-1), rather than a standard open-water current phase (group-3).
